governance_notes: Inert metadata map: links describe how an RF-ASSESS finding may qualitatively inform a universal CAP capacity. It calculates nothing, stores no user state, and creates no runtime adaptation. RF-ASSESS-001 is diagnostic context only and is not represented as a CAP evidence link in this map. RF-ASSESS-002 is safety context only and is not represented as a CAP evidence link in this map. RF-SAF rules remain safety authority. RF-DX rules remain diagnosis authority. No score, threshold, pass/fail decision, prescription, dosage, progression, readiness, RTT/RTS, triage, or clearance authority is created.
